# temps_workload_volume_attachment (Resource)

Mounts a `temps_workload_volume` into its environment's containers. Destroying it detaches the volume.

Import with `<environment_id>/<volume_id>`.

Required API key permissions: `settings:read`, `settings:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_workload_volume_attachment" "data" {
  environment_id = temps_environment.production.id
  volume_id      = temps_workload_volume.data.volume_id
  mount_path     = "/var/lib/app"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (Number) ID of the environment.
- `mount_path` (String) Absolute path in the container.
- `volume_id` (Number) ID of the volume.

### Optional

- `read_only` (Boolean) Mount it read-only.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<environment_id>/<volume_id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <environment_id>/<volume_id>
terraform import temps_workload_volume_attachment.data 21/4
```
